description: This file manages theme data in the Notesnook project, including database initialization, theme search, retrieval, and update functions using the Orama search engine.

methods.name: initializeDatabase
methods.description: Initializes the ThemesDatabase with schema and ID.

methods.name: findTheme
methods.description: Searches for a theme by ID and compatibility version.

methods.name: updateTotalInstalls
methods.description: Updates the total installs count for a given theme.

methods.name: getThemes
methods.description: Retrieves themes based on query parameters, including filters and sorting.
